grid.monolayer_definition: Manufactured coverage equivalent of 1e19 parent molecules per square metre; not a physical stainless-steel monolayer assignment.
grid.monolayer_provenance: Numerical regression fixture only; no water inventory or surface-site measurement.
grid.bin_support: Four manufactured detector bins; values are arbitrary supplied count templates, not a molecular spectrum.
grid.provenance: Piecewise-linear numerical response grid supplied for fitting verification; no CR or transport calculation.

observation.bin_support: Four manufactured detector bins; values are arbitrary supplied count templates, not a molecular spectrum.
observation.provenance: Noise-free numerical mean at coverage1.4 and calibration scale1.12, with explicit manufactured correlated Gaussian weighting covariance.

calibration.provenance: Manufactured linear-scale Gaussian penalty; no measured instrument calibration or uncertainty.

manufactured_truth.usage: Recorded for independent numerical validation only; never supplied to the optimization.
